title: Nushrratt Bharuccha Airlifted to Mumbai After Spine Fracture in Bali Accident
excerpt: The Bollywood actress suffered a spinal fracture during a work-cum-holiday trip to Bali, was flown back to Mumbai by air ambulance on October 2, and is expected to undergo spine surgery in the city.
body:
• Bollywood actress Nushrratt Bharuccha suffered a spinal fracture in an accident in Bali, where she had travelled for a combined work and holiday trip, her team confirmed on Friday, October 2.
  • She was first hospitalised in Bali under medical observation, then flown back to Mumbai the same day in an air ambulance. On arrival, she was transferred to a Mumbai hospital on a stretcher, appearing unable to walk, according to IndiaForums.
  • Her team says she will undergo spine surgery in Mumbai after further evaluation by doctors — the operation has not yet been confirmed as complete, and no recovery timeline has been announced.
  • Work commitments over the next few weeks will be put on hold, and her team has asked the public and media to respect her privacy during treatment.

Opening news lead

Bollywood actress Nushrratt Bharuccha was airlifted from Bali to Mumbai on Friday, October 2, after suffering a spinal fracture in an accident during a work-cum-holiday trip to Indonesia, her team said in an official statement. The actress, best known for Pyaar Ka Punchnama, Sonu Ke Titu Ki Sweety and Dream Girl, is expected to undergo spine surgery in Mumbai once doctors complete further evaluation.

Context & Background

According to the statement issued by her publicist and carried by IANS, Bharuccha "met with an unfortunate accident and suffered a fracture in her spine" while in Bali, and was initially hospitalised there under medical observation. The statement added: "Following further evaluation by the doctors, Nushrratt will be undergoing spine surgery." Arrangements were then made to bring her back to Mumbai via air ambulance, where the surgery will take place.

Visuals from her arrival in Mumbai on Friday showed the actress being transferred from the air ambulance to a waiting ambulance on a stretcher, surrounded by family members, close friends and medical staff, IndiaForums reported. Actress Ishita Raj was also present during the transfer. Bharuccha appeared unable to walk and was seen trying to speak as she was taken away for further medical care.

The team has not disclosed how the accident happened or which part of the spine was injured, and has released no clinical details beyond the fracture diagnosis. Days before the accident, the actress had been posting glimpses of her Bali trip on Instagram — beachwear shots and meals at coastal restaurants — captioned "Holiday on my mind! Where do I head out to now?"

"At present, our immediate priority is her health and ensuring she receives the necessary medical care. We are currently making arrangements to bring Nushrratt back to Mumbai from Bali via an air ambulance, where she will undergo the surgery."

— Official statement from Nushrratt Bharuccha's team

Impact & Analysis

The injury is a serious setback for one of Bollywood's busiest commercial stars. After her television beginnings in shows like Kitty Party and Seven, Bharuccha broke through with Love Sex Aur Dhokha (2010) and the Pyaar Ka Punchnama franchise before headlining genre fare such as the horror hit Chhorii and its sequel Chhorii 2. She was last seen in Chhorii 2 and Ufff Yeh Siyapaa, and reports had recently linked her to a new action film directed by Remo D'Souza co-starring Tiger Shroff — projects now expected to pause. Her team confirmed: "Given the nature of the injury and the surgery, Nushrratt will need time to rest and recover, and her work commitments over the next few weeks are likely to be affected."

Spinal fractures vary widely in severity, and her team has disclosed nothing about spinal cord involvement or a recovery timetable — a deliberate restraint that has kept speculation in check. The actress has not spoken publicly about the accident; all updates have come through her team.

Diaspora Angle

Bharuccha's films — from the Punchnama comedies to Dream Girl — have been reliable draws among diaspora audiences in the US, UK and the Gulf, where her fan base tracks her work closely. Bali, meanwhile, is one of the most popular holiday destinations for Indian travellers, and the air-ambulance evacuation underscores the value of robust travel insurance with medical repatriation cover for Indians vacationing abroad — a reminder for the thousands of diaspora families planning year-end trips to Southeast Asia.

What's Next

Bharuccha is now at a Mumbai hospital where doctors will decide the timing of the spine surgery after further evaluation. Her team said it will share updates "as and when appropriate" and requested privacy. Wishes have poured in from industry colleagues and fans on social media. Any revision to her shooting schedule — including the reported Tiger Shroff project — will depend on how the surgery goes and how long her recovery takes.
